messages:
marta: heads-up: deploy-bot blocked payments canary due to cross-region chart skew. leaving hold while we decide.

deploy-bot: [AUTOMATION] Promotion blocked: chart version mismatch detected. service=payments; eu-west=chart-v1.14.0(promoted); us-east=chart-v1.12.1(current); reason=preflight values-schema check failure in us-east.

jamie: Is this a staggered roll? Any hint from helm hooks?

marta: Staggered. no hooks failing; helm preflight rejects new default for job.concurrency in us-east tests.

owen: Suggest temporary pin in eu-west to v1.12.1 until we can run validation in us-east. Pin is lower blast radius than rollback.

sanjay: +1 pin 45m. I'll run DB connection pressure tests after validation.

infra-oncall: If you want to rollback eu-west we can open the window now; but pin sounds safer. Please confirm release-note delta for SRE. @jamie

jamie: release note: "job.defaultConcurrency: 5 -> 10". that's it.

marta: plan: pin eu-west to v1.12.1 for 45m, run validation & DB pressure tests in us-east, then either promote patched v1.14.0 or unpin. I'll create pin and post confirmation.

deploy-bot: Promotion hold recorded (initiator=marta). Pin applied: payments eu-west -> chart-v1.12.1; duration=45m. To unpin: `/deploybot unpin payments eu-west`.

marta: pin created and confirmed. owen, ping when validation job completes.
